description: Verified push and PR protocol corpus: success, rejection, timeout, response-loss, ref-race for push; no-push, wrong-repo, wrong-head, existing-wrong-head, missing-gh, auth-failure, malformed-json, timeout, head-lag, crash-resume, idempotent-retry for PR; all against disposable local bare repositories and fixture providers

push_failures.description: Non-fast-forward push rejected by remote; run remains non-delivered and PR-unreachable
assertions: no remote_observation with observed_remote_oid is recorded
delivery intent has no successful ls-remote observation

push_failures.description: Push command exceeds timeout deadline; run remains non-delivered
Push succeeds but process crashes before ls-remote observation; resume completes idempotently
assertions: push observation is persisted before crash
resume re-observes via ls-remote without re-pushing
ls-remote OID equals delivery OID after resume

push_failures.description: Remote ref moved after push; ls-remote shows a different OID than delivery OID
assertions: ls-remote observed OID differs from delivery OID

push_success.description: Push to local bare repo succeeds and ls-remote independently confirms the exact delivery OID
assertions: ls-remote observed OID equals delivery OID
delivery intent is persisted with exact OID/remote/branch
remote observation sequence is push=1, ls-remote=2

pr_failures.description: PR creation is impossible before a verified push observation exists
PR creation is impossible when ls-remote OID does not match delivery OID
PR from a wrong repository identity is rejected
assertions: PR protocol returns mismatch with repository reason

pr_failures.description: PR head OID differs from delivery OID is rejected
assertions: PR protocol returns mismatch with head reason

pr_failures.description: Existing PR with wrong head is rejected and not accepted; no duplicate creation
assertions: PR protocol returns mismatch with head reason
provider find is called but create is not
PR protocol returns infrastructure_error with gh in reason
PR protocol returns infrastructure_error with auth in reason
PR protocol returns infrastructure_error with malformed/json/parse in reason
PR protocol returns infrastructure_error with timeout/deadline in reason

pr_failures.description: Independent query shows lagging head OID different from delivery OID
assertions: PR protocol returns mismatch with head reason

pr_failures.description: Crash after PR creation but before observation persistence; resume resolves the same PR without duplicate
assertions: provider create is not called on resume (find resolves existing PR)
only one PR observation exists after resume

pr_failures.description: Repeated PR request resolves the same PR without duplicate creation
assertions: provider create is called exactly once across both calls

pr_failures.description: PR from a different repository identity is rejected even with correct head OID
assertions: PR protocol returns mismatch with repository reason

pr_success.description: PR created after verified push; independently queried head OID equals delivery OID and repository identity matches
assertions: observed head OID equals delivery OID
repository identity equals expected repository ID
PR observation persisted with correct provider_repository_id, head_branch, base_branch, observed_head_oid
provider create is called exactly once
